amherst-tower.title: Case Study: 32 Months of Signal in Amherst, New Hampshire
amherst-tower.dek: No FCC Antenna Structure Registration. No FAA obstruction filing. No permit in any federal database. When American Tower signed a 30-year ground lease in Amherst, New Hampshire, the only record of the deal forming was in the meeting minutes of a town of 12,000.
amherst-tower.card_body: A citizen complaint becomes a 30-year ground lease. 23-month window, 17 signals, zero federal records.

company-footprint.card_body: Entity resolution shows which public companies appear in municipal vendor payments weeks before quarterly earnings.

la-marque-credit.title: Case Study: 13 Months of Warning in La Marque, Texas
la-marque-credit.dek: Moody's downgraded La Marque, Texas from A1 to A3 in October 2025. Two notches. The rating action cited administrative turnover, declining financial position, and delayed debt service payments. Every one of those signals was visible in public documents over a year earlier.
la-marque-credit.card_body: A two-notch downgrade in October 2025. The governance signals were in the minutes 13 months earlier.

data-center-zoning.title: Maine's Data Center Fight Was Visible in Town Halls Five Months Before the State Vote
data-center-zoning.dek: Six Maine town halls, out of 173 we monitor in the state, were already discussing data center restrictions five months before LD 307 reached the Maine House. The House passed it, the Governor vetoed it, the override failed, and a different shape of restriction landed on the same day.
data-center-zoning.card_body: 6 of 173 monitored Maine towns were on the record before the state legislature took up LD 307. Every source document linked.

data-center-zoning-national.title: Data Centers Are Contested in 24 States, and the Friction Curve Is Steepening
data-center-zoning-national.dek: Municipal Alpha tracks data-center zoning and siting activity across US municipalities, surfacing it from planning-board minutes and committee agendas months before national reporting. As of May 2026, 80 distinct municipal and state records across 47 jurisdictions in 24 states showed the pattern forming.
data-center-zoning-national.card_body: Municipal Alpha tracks data-center zoning and siting activity across US municipalities, surfacing it months before national reporting. 80 records across 47 jurisdictions in 24 states.

business-retention.title: Business Retention Runs on the Worst Information. The Public Record Already Has Better.
business-retention.dek: Economic developers say retaining an existing employer is far easier than attracting a new one, yet most learn a local employer is in trouble from the news, after the window to act has closed.
business-retention.card_body: Most economic developers learn a local employer is in trouble from the news. Municipal Alpha reads town and county records across 4,400+ municipalities, where it's written down first.

cell-tower-leasing.title: How Cell-Tower Leases Get Decided Before a Broker Ever Sees Them
cell-tower-leasing.dek: Municipal Alpha tracks US cell-tower and wireless-siting decisions from town and county meeting records, surfacing lease approvals, small-cell siting, and ordinance changes weeks before they reach a broker or an RFP.
cell-tower-leasing.card_body: Lease approvals, small-cell siting, and ordinance changes surface in town and county meeting records, weeks ahead of typical RFP timing. Drawn from 161,492 FCC-registered towers across 1,105 municipalities.
